items.d: 한국산 전기차의 수출 경쟁력이 최근 2년 새 절반 가까이 떨어지면서 중국에 역전된 것으로 나타났다. 이 같은 추세가 이어지면 2030년에는 전기차 수출액이 2조 원 넘게 줄어들 수 있다고 전망했다. 4일 한국경제인협회가 유엔 무역통계를 분석해 발표한 ‘한국 전기차 수출 및 경쟁력 현황과 시사점’에 따르면 한국 전기차의 현시비교우위지수(RCA)는 2023년 2.92에서 지난해 1.48로 49.3% 하락했다. RCA는 특정 품목이 한 국가의 전체 수출 중 차지하는 비중을, 세계 교역에서 해당 품목이 차지하는 비중과 비교한 지표다. 1을 넘기면 해당 품목이 수출에 상대적인 경쟁력을 지닌 것으로 해석된다. 한국 전기차의 경우, 여전히 수출 경쟁력을 지니고 있지만 그 수준이 빠르게 약화되고 있는 것. 반면 2017년

items.t: 현대차 ‘그랜드 블루핸즈’ 2029년까지 30곳으로 늘려

Ferrari’s controversial Luce EV is sold out for 2027
items.d: The Luce, Ferrari's first electric car and one of its most polarizing models, is "fully allocated" through 2027, according to CEO Benedetto Vigna.
items.fullText: The Luce, Ferrari’s first electric car and one of its most polarizing models, isn’t just selling. It’s selling out. The five-seater EV designed by Jony Ive, Apple’s longtime design chief, was mocked and widely panned when it debuted in May, sending Ferrari’s stock price lower. But all that criticism hasn’t dampened demand, according to CEO Benedetto Vigna. The 2027 production run of the Luce, which starts at about $615,000, is “fully allocated,” Vigna said Tuesday during the company’s third-quarter earnings call, meaning every car Ferrari plans to build next year already has a buyer. “If someone comes, he has to wait one year to get the cars,” Vigna added. The first deliveries of the Luce are expected to begin in the fourth quarter. Just how many Luce cars that represents is unclear. Ferrari has never publicly disclosed how many Luce vehicles it plans to produce. Financial Times reported earlier this year, citing unnamed sources, that Ferrari planned to sell just under 500 units this year. The company’s longer-term target is to sell 2,500 units by 2030, or about 600 a year, according to Financial Times. Speculation on who these buyers are — ahem, the founders of multibillion-dollar AI labs, perhaps? — will have to remain just that until Luces are spotted in the wild. Vigna wouldn’t provide a breakdown of who these Luce customers are, only noting it was a “good mix in terms of client, it is a good mix also in terms of geography.” He later added that there is no specific pattern or demographic of Luce buyers. While Luce deliveries have yet to begin, Ferrari’s existing lineup and growing demand for personalized options helped fuel its financial performance in the third quarter . Revenue from customizations, which executives said accounted for more than 21% of revenue from cars and spare parts, helped boost profits.
